arabic_html:
وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًۭا ۞
hook:
Don't say it
if you don't know.
translation: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those one will be questioned.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr, from Qatādah: do not say I saw when you did not see, I heard when you did not hear, or I know when you do not know. Hearing, sight and heart are all asked about.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathīr, from Qatādah: do not say I saw when you did not see, I heard when you did not hear, or I know when you do not know. Hearing, sight and heart are all asked about.
